ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu; Digital Electronics students attend classes at the Green Street facility, room 202 from July 9 to July 21, Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM. Enrollment in this course section is restricted to students registering in UIUC's Project Lead The Way, Summer Training Institute. Concurrent enrollment in Project Lead The Way is a requirement.
